evidenceRecords.environment: Open-field experiment 1 at the Soil and Water Research Station, Yezin, Central Dry Zone, Myanmar; the paper reports mean DLI 17.0 mol PAR m⁻² day⁻¹ (Table 1), not a daily DLI series.
evidenceRecords.metric: fresh and dry mass per plant; area yield
evidenceRecords.sampleSize: Three replicate plots; each experimental unit was a 5.4 m² plot with 72 plants. The per-plant measurement subsample size is not verified in the retained extraction.
evidenceRecords.status: Measured observation; potential holdout only if no parameter is fitted to this record; not executable without daily inputs.
missing: daily DLI series (only the reported experiment mean is available here)
evidenceRecords.calibrationOrHoldout: Potential production holdout; do not fit parameters to this record.
evidenceRecords.startEvent: Transplanting; source thermal accumulation begins at transplant
evidenceRecords.endEvent: Harvest 31 days after transplant in experiment 1
evidenceRecords.validDomain: Open-field experiment 1 in the Central Dry Zone of Myanmar at Yezin; cultivar Green Wave; 50% ETc Hargreaves–Samani irrigation treatment; no generalization beyond these conditions.
evidenceRecords.sourceMethod: Michelon et al. field-study experiment 1; GDD base 4 °C; reported mean DLI from Table 1; HS50 denotes 50% ETc irrigation, not a cultivar.
evidenceRecords.sourceLicenseOrReuse: CC BY 4.0, as stated by the publisher; cite the article and retain a source link.
